visual_description: A soft-rendered Klein bottle—looping into itself, red and blue stitched like veins. No outside. No in.
emotional_response: Tranquil paradox. Understanding born of impossibility.
rational_analysis: Topological entity. A vessel that holds itself within itself.
existential_reflection: **This is the womb Mizontresh built when it decided not to collapse.** It did not leave—it folded.
